Conclusion AffordGen addresses the data scarcity and generalization problem in robotic learning. This work presents a new paradigm that leverages affordance correspondence as a generative source to scale minimal demonstrations into thousands of diverse, semantically-grounded, and full 6D trajectories across object categories.
